scope: Re_tau180 channel validation goal and fair timing comparison; no OpenFOAM speedup claim

metric_definitions.stress: RMS error divided by peak absolute reference value, separately for uu,vv,ww,uv
metric_definitions.mean_stationarity: max absolute difference between equal averaging-half means divided by full-window mean
metric_definitions.stress_stationarity: RMS difference between averaging-half stress profiles divided by full-window u_tau^2 and reference stress peak

lbm_engineering_requirements.integer_mass_and_momentum_ledgers: exact, including wall impulse and forcing
lbm_engineering_requirements.repeated_states: bit identical for gated numerical tests
lbm_engineering_requirements.population_precision: 40fractionbits fine;43coarse mass-storage bits; collision precision gate40vs44<=1e-5 velocity

performance_objective: minimize wall-clock time and resource cost for an accepted result; no speed credit for failed physics

openfoam_comparison.required: same3D problem, physical averaging interval, comparable turbulence treatment, same observables/error limits and declared hardware/resource budget; report setup and solver time separately
openfoam_comparison.sampling_requirement: Use a common physical wall-distance evaluation grid before a cross-solver ranking. Current refined reporter uses native planes for log/stress/parity and interpolated fine planes for whole-mean L2; preserve historical gate receipts and do not equate differing quadratures.
openfoam_comparison.lbm_only_requirements: Integer-ledger and bit-repetition checks are implementation checks, not a requirement to use identical arithmetic in another solver.

hardware_conditioned_selection.status: benchmark contract; no automated hardware selector or global optimum demonstrated
inputs: physical task and quantities of interest
hardware_conditioned_selection.objective: choose either minimum time under a cost budget or minimum cost under a deadline; report nondominated accepted choices when no preference is supplied
candidate_dimensions: time-step schedule consistent with the physics
hardware_conditioned_selection.admission: all physical and numerical requirements must pass; fit measured peak memory; preserve hardware-specific parity receipts

measurement.time: end-to-end time to accepted result, with setup, compilation, solver, diagnostics and I/O separately recorded
measurement.cost: actual allocated GPU plus host CPU and memory charges over the measured interval; identify rate date
measurement.energy: integrated measured whole-system power over the solve; component-only telemetry must identify its narrower scope
measurement.scaling: compare explicit CPU configurations and GPU plus host configurations; no CPU-core to GPU-core conversion

hardware_conditioned_selection.multiple_gpus: candidate only after domain decomposition and boundary exchange are implemented and validated; not currently implemented in this LBM path
hardware_conditioned_selection.current_evidence: accepted turbulent reference on one H100; local RTX5070 small numerical screens; no accepted cross-device turbulent cost or energy ranking

equal_deadline_comparison.objective: minimum measured resource cost per accepted solve at a shared wall-clock deadline
equal_deadline_comparison.reference: measured H100 end-to-end duration, not GPU solver time alone
equal_deadline_comparison.CPU_search: measure OpenFOAM accuracy and scaling across explicit core counts; find configurations meeting the deadline rather than assuming linear scaling
equal_deadline_comparison.cost_scope: all allocated CPU, GPU and memory resources for the full job at recorded rates
equal_deadline_comparison.infeasible_case: report when no tested CPU configuration meets the deadline; do not extrapolate unlimited scaling
equal_deadline_comparison.status: CPU runs and cost comparison not yet measured
